license: Apache-2.0 (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.recommendedGpu: CPU works (any 4-core x86_64 or Apple Silicon) — 1× T4 16GB for ~210x RTF

notes: 82M-parameter open-source TTS, Apache 2.0, no commercial restrictions. Bundles ~28 voices across American/British × female/male × multiple personality presets. The right default for Safebox tenants: small enough to run on any laptop or CPU-only VM, fast enough on consumer GPU for production volume. Pronunciation handled by espeak-ng — system dependency required.
